findings.summary: two fixtures whose stub returns three identical zero vectors are edited outside the declared write paths (encoder.py, test_embed_distinct_guard.py, the fragment); the edit is necessary and correct (the guard rejects that shape, so both tests would redden unchanged) and is disclosed in the manifest, but it needs a coordinator scope grant or the node lands a file it was not fenced to write.

embed_texts_with_result returns the same backend output through the sibling path without calling _reject_identical_vectors, so the guard does not cover every public producer of embeddings; it currently has no production caller, so the gap is latent rather than reachable.

DegenerateEmbeddingError subclasses Exception rather than EmbeddingBackendError, so callers that catch the backend error for a graceful fallback (imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:268, imas_codex/tools/graph_search.py:1821) now propagate it uncaught; visible failure is the stated intent, but the class sits outside the hierarchy those sites key on.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the guard sits on Encoder.embed_texts, which 39 production call sites invoke across imas_codex/; verified against seven that include a try/except wrapper (imas_codex/embeddings/description.py:86) and direct callers (imas_codex/graph/client.py:663, imas_codex/standard_names/search.py:57, imas_codex/llm/server.py:716).
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against c7b4c626e; the single commit 08024a354 changes exactly four paths inside/listing the declared scope: encoder.py adds DegenerateEmbeddingError and _reject_identical_vectors called on both return paths of embed_texts (+52/-2), test_embed_distinct_guard.py is new (87 lines, six tests), test_encoder.py adjusts two degenerate stub fixtures (out of declared scope), and the fragment is new (43 lines).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a zero identical-vector cluster count with the bounded query, predicate and elapsed time; a stub-backend test that is refused and fails when the guard is removed; and four gate files. The fragment records the predicate, 2528 rows and 0.67 s and the 4-clusters-to-0 result; negative_control.log shows three tests reddening with the refusal removed; gate_head.log runs all four files at 65 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make Encoder.embed_texts refuse a silent constant vector and then repair the 38 names built from one; encoder.py:413 and encoder.py:428 call _reject_identical_vectors on both return paths, and the manifest records the four clusters (sizes 18/14/4/2, 38 names) re-embedded to zero.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commit 08024a354, landing line present, gate and negative-control logs named, and the out-of-scope test_encoder.py edit disclosed as a blocker in fields 8 and 10 rather than hidden.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source declared encoder.py, tests/embeddings/test_embed_distinct_guard.py, the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-embedding-guard.html and an unused docs/figures dir; the diff touches the first three plus tests/embeddings/test_encoder.py, which is outside the declared set.

justifications.durability: tests/embeddings/test_embed_distinct_guard.py:40,47,84 assert the refusal against a stub returning one vector for distinct texts, and negative_control.log shows all three redden (DID NOT RAISE, EXIT=1) with _reject_identical_vectors removed while they pass at head.
justifications.evidence: gate_head.log and gate_base.log are retained with their summary lines (65 and 59 passed, EXIT=0) and negative_control.log keeps the reverted-guard red, but the census query itself is reported only as predicate and elapsed in the fragment (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-embedding-guard.html:17) with no raw query log to re-run.
justifications.fit: DegenerateEmbeddingError at imas_codex/embeddings/encoder.py:44 mirrors the sibling EmbeddingBackendError idiom and _reject_identical_vectors is a staticmethod on the owning class, with no plan, sprint or ticket label in any added name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/embeddings/encoder.py:413 and :428 both return through _reject_identical_vectors, so the local and remote paths and every description.py wrapper reach the guard, and the manifest records the 38 names repaired to zero clusters.
justifications.reuse: no owner for degenerate-vector detection exists in imas_codex/embeddings/ (a capability search found only unrelated cache content hashing), so _reject_identical_vectors is the first and it is placed on the canonical Encoder rather than a new module.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff reaches tests/embeddings/test_encoder.py:87 and :597, which are outside the declared write paths, even though the change is necessary and disclosed; the other three paths are inside scope.
